# divorcerbot

> UK divorce self-help (E&W/Scotland/NI) that levels the playing field: verified law, CMS calculator, cited case-law strategy, BYOK/WebLLM analyser. Not legal advice.

divorcerbot is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.

## Key pages

- [Live page](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/divorcerbot/)
- [Repository](https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/divorcerbot)
- [The estate](https://www.ai-nativesolutions.com/)
